reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V3 (linear-bicycle steady-state: psi_dot = v*(delta-bias)/ratio_scale / (L + Kus*v^2)) using per-platform parameters reported in REPORT.md and out/run2.txt; applied to all canonical Ford sim.csv segments.
notes: Parameters were fit by the agent on an 80% train split of these same Ford segments; per the canonical leakage_note we accept this. Steering bias converted from steering-wheel degrees to road-wheel radians by dividing by nominal i_s before radians conversion.
